## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This one-fascicle text is the structural-outline (*kē* 科) by [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Guīfēng Zōngmì 圭峰宗密 (780–841, the fifth Huáyán patriarch) of his master [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān's *[Xíng yuàn pǐn shū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0069)* (X227). The *kē* genre — the hierarchical heading-table that served as the navigational map for a major Buddhist commentary — was a standard component of Tang-Sòng Buddhist scholastic apparatus.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to the period 820 – 841 CE, the bracket of [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's mature scholarly activity at the Cǎotángsì 草堂寺 on Mt. Guīfēng 圭峰山 (Huáyánsì 華嚴寺). The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The work belongs to a small but doctrinally significant corpus of Zōngmì's editorial-commentarial extensions of his master Chéngguān's *Avataṃsaka*-related writings; through such editorial activity Zōngmì consolidated the Chéngguān corpus and ensured its continuing study in the late-Tang period.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X228) collection.
